The Cardinal, led by third-year head coach [[Jerod Haase]], played their home games at [[Maples Pavilion]] as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. == Previous season == The [[2017-18 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Cardinal]] finished the [[2017-18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017-18 season]] 19–16, 11–7 in [[2017-18 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in a three-way tie for third place; this was their most conference wins in a decade (since 2008). They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to [[2017-18 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]]. They qualified for the [[2018 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]], beating [[2017-18 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] in the first round, but lost to [[2017-18 Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball team|Oklahoma State]] in the second round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:100%;" border="1" !
